messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Sentinel scan failure rate >= 50% for service=sentinel-prober in region=eu-west-1. Auto-page triggered.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-48321 triggered: high failure rate from synthetic checks (sentinel). Priority: P1. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/synthetic-failures
pagerduty-bot: notes: 75% of probes failing since 2m. Affected probe pool: sentinel-eu-west-1-0..3.
sre_jamie: acked INC-48321. I'm on it, starting triage. Can someone confirm customer-facing impact?
oncall-ian: I see a small uptick in 5xxs for hosted inference in eu-west but not global. Latency looks normal. Might be probe-only.
maria_g: confirmed - alerting on internal probe failures, haven't seen elevated errors in customer logs. I queried traces: only synthetic endpoints returning 502 from prober nodes.
devops-tyler: pulling pod logs now: `kubectl -n prober logs sentinel-prober-0` shows repeated `connect: connection reset by peer` to synthetic gateway. Possible network egress issue.
observability-bot: quick metric: prober egress error rate +300% from 5143219700-5143219860. Route table shows 3 failed NAT IPs in eu-west.
sre_jamie: ok that's consistent. Is it just the NAT pool? Can we rotate to spare NATs?
devops-tyler: initiating NAT rotation: `infractl network rotate-nat --region eu-west-1 --pool sentinel-prober`. Will take ~30s. Patching now.
incident-bot: ACTION: Silencing pagerduty noise for 15m for rule=switchback-probe-failure to avoid duplicates.
pd-ops: noted. Keep PD incident open until confirmed recovered.
maria_g: after NAT rotation, probes are back to ~95% success in the dashboard. Patch seemed to fix prober egress. Still watching for flapping.
oncall-ian: any customer impact? Should we page product or CSE?
sre_jamie: no customer-facing errors observed. This appears to be synthetic-only. Recommend no customer pages. I'll keep monitoring for 30m then start a post-incident note.
devops-tyler: adding a short-term mitigation: increase prober redundancy and add a fallback egress route. Filing infra ticket: INFRA-7842.
pagerduty-bot: INC-48321: status=acknowledged, responder=sre_jamie. Next escalation if unacked in 15m to oncall-rotation.
incident-bot: Handoff: @oncall-ian you're next for monitoring window. I'll tag this thread for 30m watch and post a short RCA skeleton after cool-down. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
pd-ops: closing notes for now: incident remains open but no customer impact. Marking severity as 'observability-only'. Please update incident tags with root_cause=natted-egress and mitigation=nat-rotation.
sre_jamie: adding immediate follow-ups: (1) confirm NAT pool health checks, (2) automate NAT failover in prober runbook, (3) notify infra team. I'll draft a quick postmortem later today.
oncall-ian: ack. Taking watch. If it flaps again, escalate to infra on-call and re-open PD.
incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED (monitoring mode). Summary: transient NAT egress failures caused sentinel synthetic probes to fail; NAT rotation restored probe success. No customer-facing errors detected.
